subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw support Browserbase session lifecycle as a first-party bundled browser driver, or should this wait for a generic browser backend/plugin API that third-party session-managed CDP providers can implement?
rationale: The fix crosses commercial-service integration, config/schema surface, credential handling, signed connectUrl redaction, session cleanup, and browser-control security boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise Browserbase driver PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83306 as the candidate fix after route coverage, redaction, credential policy, merge conflicts, and real OpenClaw browser-tool proof are resolved.

options.title: Design generic backend seam first
options.body: Keep this issue tied to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/19289 if maintainers want Browserbase and similar providers to live behind a generic plugin/API contract.

options.title: Document limitation only
options.body: Remove or narrow the Browserbase static cdpUrl recommendation until maintainers are ready to support the Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise Browserbase driver PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83306 as the candidate fix after route coverage, redaction, credential policy, merge conflicts, and real OpenClaw browser-tool proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent browser/plugin-boundary ownership signal for the product/API decision.
